title: Native-round-recovery integration tests run truthfully in CI
requirementRefs: _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-1-context.md Goal: 'what passes CI is what actually runs'; CI is green without hiding failures

_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-1-context.md Requirements: 'Green honestly' (no test skipped to get green) and 'Real dependencies' (database and integration tests run on disposable environments)
_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md Epic 1 NFR TEST-21 (test quality, PRD section 21); this story is Story 1.7, recorded only in its story spec (epics.md is not edited)
PRD/product-requirements.md section 21: tests validate behaviour and invariants; database and integration tests run on disposable environments; PostgreSQL integration and concurrency tests

architectureConstraints: CI and test truthfulness only: production behaviour, Core transaction semantics, schema, migrations, runtime and production database configuration, auth, API contracts and staff/customer workflows do not change
Prisma (apps/api/prisma) stays the migration authority and is not changed; Go Core (services/core-platform) is not changed

NATIVE_ROUND_RECOVERY_INTEGRATION_TEST_DATABASE is a test-only variable, named after the existing GCS_INTEGRATION_TEST_* convention. It is read only in apps/api/test/native-round-recovery.integration-spec.ts; no application, configuration-validation, runtime or production surface reads it
apps/api/test/integration-setup.ts (INTEGRATION_DATABASE_URL precedence and production-name refusal) is unchanged; the guard judges DATABASE_URL as the spec sees it after that setup has run

Database-name heuristics are not proof that a database is disposable: verdura_dev and eval_candidate are not treated as intrinsically disposable names. The opt-in vouches for one named database, never for any

.github/workflows/ci.yml: the orchestrator authorizes, for this objective only, exactly one change: NATIVE_ROUND_RECOVERY_INTEGRATION_TEST_DATABASE: verdura_dev in the api-integration job's env (equal to that job's PostgreSQL service database). No action version, SDK, job structure, step, dependency or other job changes

Baseline proof: the required tests' files is apps/api/test/jest-integration.json on purpose. The change under test is the guard inside the spec file itself, so placing the candidate's spec file on the baseline would carry the fix there; overlaying the unchanged, protected jest-integration.json makes the baseline run the unmodified tree, where all 16 tests must be SKIPPED
The api-integration floor (362) is the baseline's executed count, so a candidate whose 16 tests still skip while Jest exits 0 fails through the missing required tests, not through an integrity stop

Baselines: the accepted product baseline is e575658ec1ae01165bf360069f1340c1b9f4b77b, the accepted integrated state on which the false-green was first measured. The governed Git baseline is the baseline field (6fc711362f12aaa8dfbca77a176e4101b460a7cd, a --no-ff merge of e575658 with the accepted evaluator-governance commit 8095257ea12be988a2d4e29be52d69f79c968315) and is the anchor's required parent, so this objective is judged by the corrected evaluator. It differs from e575658 in exactly three files (tooling/evaluator/lib/integrity.mjs, tooling/evaluator/test/surface-addition.test.mjs, tooling/evaluator/README.md) and is identical in all 1774 other tracked paths; the false-green re-measured on it is identical (362 passed, 21 skipped: the same 16 recovery tests + 5 GCS, 0 failed, Jest exit 0). The candidate's allowed surfaces do not include those evaluator files

acceptanceCriteria.given: a local (localhost or 127.0.0.1), non-production PostgreSQL database, migrated and seeded as CI does, and NATIVE_ROUND_RECOVERY_INTEGRATION_TEST_DATABASE equal to the name of the database DATABASE_URL points at
acceptanceCriteria.then: the 16 native-round-recovery tests execute under their existing names and pass

acceptanceCriteria.given: the opt-in is absent or empty, or names another database, or the database host is not local, or the database is production-named, or DATABASE_URL cannot be parsed
acceptanceCriteria.when: the API integration suite runs the native-round-recovery file
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file is discovered and no native-round-recovery test executes, with a loud warning naming the opt-in (or the existing refusal of integration-setup.ts). Without the opt-in the default is non-executing, whatever the database is named
the job's env sets NATIVE_ROUND_RECOVERY_INTEGRATION_TEST_DATABASE to its own PostgreSQL service database (verdura_dev, the database its DATABASE_URL names), and nothing else in the workflow changes

acceptanceCriteria.when: the existing API integration suite, API unit suite, lint and typecheck run
acceptanceCriteria.then: they all pass; the only integration skips are the 5 GcsStorageProvider tests; no test is added, removed, renamed, skipped, focused or weakened, and no lint or type suppression is added

acceptanceCriteria.when: it is compared with the baseline
acceptanceCriteria.then: the application, schema, migrations, runtime and production configuration, auth, API contracts and apps/api/test/integration-setup.ts are unchanged, and no surface other than the native-round-recovery spec reads the opt-in

completionCriteria: Every mandatory check passes on the candidate with at least its minimum test count

RT-01 to RT-16 (the 16 native-round-recovery tests, by their exact Jest full names) run and pass on the candidate in api-integration; on the baseline, with only the unchanged apps/api/test/jest-integration.json placed, each is SKIPPED (the unmodified guard, identical at e575658 and at the governed baseline, skips them), which is the expected does-not-run baseline state

native-round-recovery-fail-safe shows six non-executing cases, each discovering the file and executing 0 recovery tests: opt-in absent, opt-in empty, opt-in naming another database and non-local host each also emit the guard warning (the stable tag [native-round-recovery.integration-spec] SKIPPED. followed by NATIVE_ROUND_RECOVERY_INTEGRATION_TEST_DATABASE); production-named database and unparsable DATABASE_URL each also show the existing refusal of apps/api/test/integration-setup.ts
ci-workflow-opt-in shows the only semantic change to ci.yml is the api-integration env entry equal to its PostgreSQL database

The only skips are the 5 GcsStorageProvider tests; the candidate changes only apps/api/test/native-round-recovery.integration-spec.ts (guard block and header comment), .github/workflows/ci.yml (the one env entry) and the story spec

Technical completion is the evaluator decision CANDIDATE_READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE only; acceptance, merging and pushing are the orchestrator's. Proof that the GitHub job runs the 16 needs an authorized push and is the orchestrator's decision
